title: Public API experiencing severe latency and intermittent timeouts
alert_or_symptom: The Public API Gateway remains reachable, but customer-facing API requests are experiencing severe latency and intermittent timeouts across multiple business operations.

technical_evidence.observation: The API gateway p95 response time increased from a normal baseline of 650 milliseconds to 18.4 seconds between 10:06 and 10:26.
Of 96,400 requests during the affected interval, 31.8 percent timed out while 68.2 percent completed successfully. Successful responses continued throughout the interval.

Elevated end-to-end duration is present across product, authentication, inventory and order request paths. The traces do not isolate a single directly responsible downstream service or technical condition.
Customers using both the web and mobile channels report very slow page updates, intermittent request failures and abandoned shopping sessions.
No application exception, DNS failure, routing failure, compute failure, database failure, authentication failure, deployment defect or configuration error has been directly established.

service_impact.user_impact_description: The Public API Gateway remains available, but severe latency and intermittent timeouts are disrupting customer browsing, authentication, stock checks and order submission across the United Kingdom and Ireland.
service_impact.business_function_affected: Customer-facing digital shopping and transaction processing
service_impact.workaround_description: Some requests succeed when attempted later, but no approved workaround restores reliable service and repeated transaction submission is discouraged.

environmental_context: The Public API Gateway is a Tier 1 business-critical platform service.
It routes external requests to authentication, order, payment and inventory services.
Successful API responses continue to be recorded, so the service is not completely unavailable.
reported_unknowns: The directly responsible technical component or performance bottleneck has not been identified.
The individual latency contribution and health of each relevant dependency have not been independently established.
The expected duration and recovery time for the degradation are unknown.
additional_context: No data loss, corruption or serious security exposure has been confirmed.
No complete outage of the Public API Gateway has occurred during the observed interval.
